deficits.suggestion: Create a continuous footway along the left side to provide a safe pedestrian route.
Create a continuous footway along the right side to provide a safe pedestrian route.
Install a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the marked crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait.
Install dropped kerbs at both ends of the marked crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and pedestrians with mobility aids.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.

ratings.reason: A footway is clearly visible on the left side of the road in all frames.
The right side of the road is partially obscured by vehicles, but there is evidence of a footway/pavement area.
The crossing is not signalised; it is a zebra crossing, and the road width does not appear to necessitate a refuge.
The frames show pedestrians with suitcases crossing easily, and the kerb appears to be dropped/levelled.
Street lighting poles are visible in the background and along the street.
